videos.title: Rock Royalty! Queen
videos.overview: In many people's opinion Queen are the greatest British band in the world! Sit back and enjoy as we play their biggest hits back to back!

videos.title: Great British Rock
videos.overview: From Joy Division to The Stones, Zeppelin to Queen. Some of the best bands in the world came right here from the UK!

videos.title: The All Night Rock Party!
videos.overview: Rock party anthems from Queen, Meatloaf, Kaiser Chiefs, Foo Fighters and a range of other talents.

videos.title: High School Rock Out: 1995-2005
videos.overview: We open the high school year book with Weezer in 1995 and remember the amazing bands that rocked every school party through to 2005.

videos.title: 50 Rock Heroes of the 90s!
videos.overview: Claire Sturgess relives her 50 greatest rock heroes with the music that defined the 90s! Blur, Foo Fighthers, Oasis and Nirvana are all in the top 10 - but who is at number 1?

videos.title: The 90s: Guitars, Grunge & Glory!
videos.overview: Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger & everyone brought riffs, anthems & questionable hair!

videos.title: All Killer: Stateside Anthems!
videos.overview: In order, 20 of the biggest american anthems from the 21st Century featuring The Killers, Bon Jovi, Nickleback and One Republic.

videos.title: The New Legends Of Rock
videos.overview: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more!

videos.title: 50 Reasons The 10s Rocked!
videos.overview: 50 anthems of rock from the 2010s! With the 1975, Wolf Alice, Linkin Park, Royal Blood, Paramore, Biffy Clyro, YUNGBLUD & much more!

videos.title: Weekend Anthems!
videos.overview: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

videos.title: 30 Biggest Rock Anthems!
videos.overview: 30 of the biggest, timeless anthems! Featuring legendary acts like Aerosmith, Kiss, and Queen, through to Razorlight, Fall Out Boy and Evanescence.

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.overview: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss and Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore and The White Stripes.

videos.title: Nicky Horne's Rock Party Anthems
videos.overview: Nicky Horne presents his favourite 30 rock party anthems of all time, featuring Led Zeppelin, Def Leppard, Thin Lizzy and David Bowie.

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.overview: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss and Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore and The White Stripes.

videos.title: All Killer: 00s Karaoke!
videos.overview: Turn your amp up to 11 & make your mic roar! Here come 25 of the greatest 00s rock karaoke tracks. Featuring The Killers, Fall Out Boy, Arctic Monkeys & many more!

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.overview: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss and Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore and The White Stripes.

videos.title: Yeah Baby! It's the 60s!
videos.overview: 25 classic 60s hits that defined an era! Turn on, tune in and rock out to The Stones, The Beatles, Jimi Hendrix, Bob Dylan and many more legends of classic rock!

videos.title: Rock Number 1s! 1970-1979
videos.overview: An hour of rockin' chart toppers through the 70s with hits from Jimi Hendrix, Alice Cooper, Suzi Quatro and Queen.

videos.title: 70s v 80s Rock Legends!
videos.overview: Thirty hit songs, 15 top rock legends - one track as they were in the '70s, and another in the '80s - simple!

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.overview: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

videos.title: The Classic Rock 101!
videos.overview: To celebrate the launch of NOW Rock TV, we've compiled a brand new classic 101, celebrating 5 decades of rock - from the 60s to the 00s. Which guitar legends will be at number 1?

videos.title: Heart & Soul: 50 Rock Ballads
videos.overview: Carol Decker from T'Pau with 50 Rock Ballads written from the Heart and Soul! With Queen, Bon Jovi, The Cutting Crew and Bonnie Tyler.

videos.title: Blazing Rock Ballads!
videos.overview: Rock ballads from Queen, Bon Jovi, Whitesnake, Meat Loaf, Nickleback and Evanescence.
